issues.description: ACL root fast-path uses ns.HasParent(a.root) and may fail for same-namespace or escalation cases
issues.detail: In vault/acl.go AllowOperation, the check `ns.HasParent(a.root)` likely returns false when ns equals a.root, so a root-policy ACL in namespace X would deny operations on X itself. The check should also handle equality (ns == a.root) and add tests for same-ns, sibling, and child-token-targets-parent cases.

issues.description: NamespaceSealed stub unconditionally returns false, masking sealed-namespace semantics for dependent callers
issues.detail: Core.NamespaceSealed in vault/core.go is a TODO stub returning false. ListAllNamespaces and other callers rely on this signal, so sealed namespaces are silently treated as unsealed until SealManager lands. Gate behind a feature flag, log on use, or block merge until the real implementation exists.

issues.description: Removal of root-namespace restriction on root policy weakens a key security invariant
issues.detail: NewACL previously rejected the `root` policy outside the root namespace; that guard is deleted. Any caller constructing a Policy{Name:"root"} under a non-root context now silently produces a root-equivalent ACL scoped to that namespace. Audit all NewACL call sites and add explicit gating for who may mint namespace-scoped root ACLs.

issues.description: ErrNamespaceSealed detection uses substring match instead of sentinel error comparison
issues.detail: sdk/logical/response_util.go uses errwrap.Contains on the literal string `namespace is sealed`. Any wrapped error whose message happens to include that phrase will be coerced to 503. Prefer errors.Is(err, consts.ErrNamespaceSealed) for sentinel detection consistent with idiomatic Go error handling.

issues.description: AdjustErrorStatusCode switch refactor changes precedence between sealed errors and HTTPCodedError
issues.detail: The conversion from sequential if-blocks to a switch makes cases mutually exclusive. Previously an error matching both ErrSealed and HTTPCodedError would have the coded status win; now the first case short-circuits and returns 503. Confirm the new precedence is intentional and document it.

issues.description: ListAllNamespaces->ListNamespaces substitution may silently change filtering semantics in MFA, metrics, and token-count paths
issues.detail: Multiple Core methods (loadLoginMFAConfigs, runLockedUserEntryUpdates, entityGaugeCollector, countActiveTokens) switched from namespaceStore.ListAllNamespaces(ctx, true) to c.ListNamespaces(ctx). These methods likely differ in root-namespace inclusion, ctx scoping, or sealed handling. Verify semantic equivalence or document the intentional exclusion before merge.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR lays groundwork for per-namespace root tokens and namespace sealing but ships with multiple correctness and security risks. The highest-priority issues are in vault/acl.go: the HasParent-based root fast-path is under-tested and likely misbehaves for the same-namespace case, and the removal of the root-policy/root-namespace invariant broadens privilege scope without replacement gating. The NamespaceSealed stub returning false silently nullifies the new sealed-error and listing pathways. Lower-priority but real: substring matching for ErrNamespaceSealed, the switch-precedence change in AdjustErrorStatusCode, and the ListAllNamespaces->ListNamespaces swap in MFA/metrics paths all need verification before merge.
